posts.title: Family meet to start

posts.title: Thanks to the Father of lights
posts.description: To the Lord Almighty, the Father of lights, thanks for: a time to rest and write in recent days; finishing the project of words that describe our service to Christ, Do amor ao zelo ; friends to help with decisions about books. Tomorrow we travel to our annual family gathering. Clothes and coats have been washed. Grateful for family who want to be together.
